craft_notes: Sthāyin: non-difference stated (shining refuses second). Rows: row 2 (shines-not→leave). Close: rest (ādikam as and-the-rest: the list closes flat). Rejected: 'nonduality' label — killed: kept shining-talk (the verse never names advaya); taming the terror-list — kept sword-plunge-fire-thunder whole.

lines: Nothing shining stands apart from shine; though difference be said to shine,
in shining it shines not — leave grasping its breakings.
Dream turned dream, mere play, no fright-maker:
sword, plunge, fire-eating, thunder, and the rest.
l4.sanskrit_cite: yad yad bhāti na bhānataḥ pṛthag idaṃ bhedo 'pi bhātīti ced | bhāne so 'pi na bhāti kiṃ jahi tatas tadbhaṅgibhaṅgagraham | svapne svapnatayā prathāṃ gatavati krīḍaiva no bhītikṛc | chastrāghātajalāvapātahutabhuṅnirghātabandhādikam

reads_against.argmap: What shines? → Non-difference of appearance and awareness: difference is not a second shining; grasping modes of breaking is abandoned.
c1_essence: Whatever shines is not apart from shining; difference does not add a second shining — grasping its breaking-ways abandoned; dream mere play.
